zh.name: 极简风 · 方法改进
zh.summary: 先看完整循环，再分步讲清怎么执行、检查和调整，让方法越用越顺。
zh.useWhen: 学习方法、创作复盘、训练和习惯改进。
zh.instructions: 提供目标、完整步骤、检验方法、反馈以及下一轮的调整条件。
zh.output: 一组可编辑的小红书图文，默认 3 页。

en.name: Minimal Feedback Loop
en.summary: Show what to do, how to check it, and how the results change the next attempt.
en.useWhen: Learning methods, creative practice, and habit improvement.
en.instructions: Provide the goal, steps, feedback signal, and what changes on the next pass.
en.output: An editable Xiaohongshu carousel, typically three pages.
